user.title: DUT Weekly Schedule - Keyword Alerts
user.description:
Each LINE is one keyword group (creates its own sensor). Syntax: 'Label: variant 1, variant 2, ...' — combine full name + abbreviations in one group. No ':' means the whole line is a single keyword. Example:
{example}

data.weeks_ahead: Extra weeks to check (0 = current week only)

error.no_keywords: Please enter at least one valid keyword group (one per line).
